name: shdr-30
title: SHDR-30
description: A flower meadow folding into itself, falling forever toward a blue vanishing point: the log of the Chebyshev norm turns nested square frames into a continuous index, so every fragment maps back into one base picture and that picture contains itself. Sky, cloud, canopy, water and hashed flowers are painted in base-frame coordinates so the same weather repeats at every scale, the wall smear falls out of sampling the land noise on distance-around-the-frame against frame index, and aerial haze keyed to the screen radius makes the middle read as far away rather than merely small.
